title: 第一卷 第13章 收获出赃第一卷 第14章 太极
content_zh:
“那郑老爷看上了我嫂子，派来的却是长工刘勇，我穿越之前，前身松口答应了他，等到月底一过，对方恐怕不会善罢甘休，到时候第一个找上门来的肯定是这个刘勇。”
李乘风背着猎物往家走，心中思索，眼里闪过一抹冷意，“以对方浑不吝的性子，要是没一个好身板，只怕不好打发。”
李乘风一边说着，一边盘算了一下时间，发现从明天算起，距离月底已经只剩下了十天了。
十天……
“有山羊肉，还有家里剩下的肉，面，还有盐，以及从刘宏家里抢到的钱，明天去集市里把这兔子和野鸡卖了，买点油回来，我就不用再去捕猎，也一样能吃饱喝足，营养充分。”
李乘风看了看前面渐渐出现在视线里的巷子，心中思索，“十天，全力练武，以我面板的神奇，一定能大增我的力气和体格！”
有了好身板，刘勇上门纠缠的时候，才能应付拖延过去。
至于郑老爷……
从对方只是让一个长工来办这事看，应该不是特别在意这件事。
所以，只要把刘勇应付过去，应该能拖延一些时间。
只要多拖延拖延，说不得他就能凭借自己前世的武功，借助面板的神奇，修炼到这个世界武者的地步。
等到他成了武者，李乘风就不信这郑老爷会愿意为了一个女人，和他翻脸。
至于刘勇，到那时，他的问题，也就不再是问题了！
“练武！”
李乘风想到自己前世收集到的各种武功，眼神里露出了一抹精光，抬起脚步，步履坚定地走向自己家里。
等他回到自己家里的时候，太阳距离西边天际尚有一指距离。
“玉娘，开门，我回来了。”
李乘风走到院子外面敲了敲院门，轻声对着里面呼喊。
虽然是篱笆院子，但是也安了一个小木门，这样才有自己家院子的感觉，不过仅有人胸口那么的篱笆院墙，挡不了什么视线就罢了。
好在柳生声音一响，里面的柳玉娘就察觉了过来，立即抬步走了出来，急急忙忙地走到院门里面，把门打开。

“回来了，乘风，快进来。”
刘玉娘把门一打开，目光就在李乘风身上上下看着，检查一边见他身上没事，顿时松了口气，急忙地开口，侧身将他让了进来。
李乘风笑着走进去，刘玉娘立马把院门一关，拉着他走进里面屋子里。
“乘风，怎么样，没出什么事吧？”
刘玉娘进屋后把门一关，看着李乘风的眼睛，神色紧张地开口。
“没事，能有啥事？”
李乘风笑着摇了摇头，将背后背着的麻袋往地上一放，伸手拍了拍，笑眯眯地看着刘玉娘，“不仅没事，还大有所获。”
话音落下，李乘风把袋子一抖，一只竹鼠、三个兔子、三只山鸡，连带着硕大的山羊一起从袋子里滚了出来。
刘玉娘见竹鼠出来的时候脸上露出笑容，兔子出来的时候高兴的笑了笑，山鸡出来的时候眼睛亮了，结果，又一只大山羊出来了。
她瞬间睁大了眼睛，不敢置信，脑袋晕晕的看着李乘风，“羊？山羊！”
“对，山羊。今天运气好，撞到了一头山羊，手里又拿的好弓好箭，直接让我一箭给收拾了。”
李乘风笑眯眯地开口，随后伸伸懒腰，看着刘玉娘满面笑容，“还得劳烦玉娘在家先把这羊皮羊肉给收拾了，其他的东西我拿去集市上，趁着晚市给卖了，买口铁锅回来，咱今晚煮羊肉吃。”
“好，好，好！”
刘玉娘激动的都懵了，等听到李乘风的话回过神来，满脸都是惊喜，高兴得连连点头，满眼崇拜的看着李乘风，“乘风，你真厉害！”
“这才哪到哪，厉害的地方多了去呢。”
李乘风轻笑了一声，拍了拍刘玉娘的肩膀，让她在家里等着。
随后自己拎着野兔野鸡，连带着那只竹鼠又拿了一些刘宏的铜钱和老猎人给的小银子一起出门，赶向集市。
刘玉娘激动的晕乎乎的，满脸红晕的送他出门，等李乘风走出院子了才回过头来，拿着刀仔细珍惜的处理山羊尸体，激动的手都有些抖。
她对着手呸了好几口，才缓过来，高兴的眼里露出泪花，一点一点的剥着山羊皮，心里只感觉满满的激动与欣喜。
‘乘风，居然能补到这么大的猎物回来。’

刘玉娘一念至此，脸上越发的红润，小巧圆挺的屁股被裤子包裹着蹲在地上，白皙的手臂握着刀，用力的割着羊皮。
“……”
content_en:
"Then Mr. Zheng fell in love with my sister-in-law, but the one he sent was the long-term worker Liu Yong. Before I traveled through time, my predecessor agreed to him. When the end of the month is over, I'm afraid the other party won't give up. The first person to come to my door will definitely be Liu Yong."
Li Chengfeng walked home with his prey on his back, thinking in his heart, with a cold look in his eyes, "With his generous temper, if he doesn't have a good body, I'm afraid it won't be easy to get rid of him."
As Li Chengfeng spoke, he calculated the time and found that starting from tomorrow, there were only ten days left until the end of the month.
Ten days…
"I have goat meat, leftover meat at home, noodles, salt, and the money I grabbed from Liu Hong's house. I will go to the market tomorrow to sell the rabbits and pheasants and buy some oil. Then I won't have to hunt anymore, and I will still be able to eat, drink, and be fully nourished."
Li Chengfeng looked at the alley that gradually appeared in front of him and thought to himself, "Ten days of practicing martial arts with all my strength. With the magic of my faceplate, I will definitely be able to greatly increase my strength and physique!"
With a good body, Liu Yong can deal with the delay when he comes to harass him.
As for Master Zheng...
Judging from the fact that the other party just asked a long-term worker to do this, he probably didn't care about it particularly.
Therefore, as long as Liu Yong is dealt with, it should be able to delay some time.
As long as he delays for a long time, there is no way he will be able to cultivate to the level of a warrior in this world by relying on his martial arts in his previous life and the magic of the panel.
When he became a warrior, Li Chengfeng didn't believe that Mr. Zheng would be willing to fall out with him for a woman.
As for Liu Yong, by then, his problem will no longer be a problem!
"Practice martial arts!"
Li Chengfeng thought about the various martial arts he had collected in his previous life, his eyes shone brightly, he raised his feet and walked firmly towards his home.
When he returned to his home, the sun was still a finger's distance away from the western sky.
"Yu Niang, open the door, I'm back."
Li Chengfeng walked outside the courtyard, knocked on the door, and shouted softly inside.
Although it is a fenced yard, a small wooden gate is installed so that it feels like your own yard. However, the fenced yard wall is only as big as a person's chest and cannot block the view.
Fortunately, as soon as Liu Sheng's voice sounded, Liu Yuniang inside noticed it and immediately walked out, hurriedly walked to the courtyard door and opened it.
"We're back, Chengfeng, come in quickly."
As soon as Liu Yuniang opened the door, she looked up and down at Li Chengfeng. While checking, she saw that he was fine. She breathed a sigh of relief, spoke hurriedly, and let him in sideways.
Li Chengfeng walked in with a smile, and Liu Yuniang immediately closed the courtyard door and pulled him into the room inside.
"Chengfeng, how are you? Nothing happened?"
Liu Yuniang closed the door after entering the house, looked into Li Chengfeng's eyes, and spoke nervously.
"It's okay, what can happen?"
Li Chengfeng smiled and shook his head, put the sack on his back on the ground, stretched out his hand to pat it, and looked at Liu Yuniang with a smile, "Not only is it okay, but I also gained a lot."
As he finished speaking, Li Chengfeng shook the bag, and a bamboo rat, three rabbits, three pheasants, and a huge goat rolled out of the bag.
Liu Yuniang smiled happily when she saw the bamboo rat coming out, smiled happily when the rabbit came out, and her eyes lit up when the pheasant came out. As a result, another big goat came out.
Her eyes widened in disbelief, and she looked at Li Chengfeng with her head dizzy, "Sheep? Goat!"
"Yes, goat. I was lucky today. I bumped into a goat. I also had a good bow and arrows in my hand, so I killed it with one arrow."
Li Chengfeng spoke with a smile, then stretched and looked at Liu Yuniang with a smile on her face, "I have to trouble Yuniang to pack up the sheepskin and mutton at home first. I will take the other things to the market and sell them in the evening market to buy iron."When the pot comes back, let's cook the mutton tonight. "
"Okay, okay, okay! "
Liu Yuniang was so excited that she came to her senses after hearing Li Chengfeng's words. Her face was full of surprise, she nodded her head happily, and looked at Li Chengfeng with admiration, "Chengfeng, you are so awesome! "
"Where is this? There are so many great places. "
Li Chengfeng chuckled, patted Liu Yuniang on the shoulder, and asked her to wait at home.
Then he took the hare, pheasant, the bamboo rat, some copper coins from Liu Hong and the small silver given by the old hunter and went out to the market.
Liu Yuniang was so excited that she sent him out with a blush on her face. She waited for Li Chengfeng to walk out of the yard before she turned around. She handled the goat carcass carefully and carefully with a knife, her hands shaking with excitement.
She pouted into her hands several times before she recovered. With tears in her eyes of joy, she skinned the goat bit by bit, feeling full of excitement and joy in her heart.
‘Chengfeng is actually able to bring back such a big prey. ’
When Liu Yuniang thought about this, her face became more and more rosy. Her small and round ass was wrapped in pants and she squatted on the ground. She held a knife in her white arm and cut the sheepskin vigorously.
"..."
